scenarios.name: add-password
scenarios.why: '02ACUS': INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_SECURE for customer 11 (in CUSTOMER, no password row yet) is SQLCODE 0; D2-RETURN-CODE '00'; GenApp's own default password, state 'N', 0 changes

scenarios.name: add-password-count-max
scenarios.why: D2-CUSTSECR-COUNT PIC X(4) '9999' MOVEd to the S9(9) COMP host variable (an alphanumeric sender read as an unsigned integer): pass_changes 9999; the password filled to its 32 bytes

scenarios.name: add-password-count-leading-zeros
scenarios.why: count '0042' -> 42; a short password: CHAR(32) keeps its trailing blanks

scenarios.name: add-password-blanks
scenarios.why: password and state all spaces: the row holds 32 blanks and one blank, not NULL

scenarios.name: add-password-return-code-reset

commarea.D2-CUSTSECR-DATA: trailing data the program never reads

scenarios.why: a non-zero D2-RETURN-CODE on entry is reset to '00'; D2-CUSTSECR-DATA is left as passed

scenarios.name: request-add-customer-id
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER: '01ACUS' (LGACDB01's own request id) is not '02ACUS': '99', RETURN, no INSERT

scenarios.name: request-lowercase
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER: the comparison is byte for byte, '02acus' is not '02ACUS': '99'

scenarios.name: request-blank
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER: a blank request id: '99'

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: IF EIBCALEN IS EQUAL TO ZERO -- EM-VARIABLE ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (it writes the message to TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS: #4607), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea-insert-fails
scenarios.why: #4270 (X23): the caller passed 60 bytes (EIBCALEN 60; every field the INSERT reads lies in them) and INSERT-CUSTOMER-PASSWORD's INSERT (line 166) fails -803: '98', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG, then IF EIBCALEN < 91 is true -- DFHCOMMAREA(1:60) into CA-DATA and the second LINK, whose 104-byte WRITEQ from LGSTSQ's 95-byte WRITE-MSG is refused (X6): judged up to it

notes: GenApp's Db2 'add customer password' (LGACDB02, LINKed by LGACDB01 after its INSERT INTO CUSTOMER, with D2-CUSTOMER-NUM the new customer): '02ACUS' INSERTs one CUSTOMER_SECURE row from D2-CUSTOMER-NUM (9(10) -> S9(9) COMP), D2-CUSTSECR-PASS, D2-CUSTSECR-STATE and D2-CUSTSECR-COUNT (X(4) -> S9(9) COMP); any other request id sets D2-RETURN-CODE '99' and RETURNs. The COMMAREA (32500 bytes, LGACDB02's own DFHCOMMAREA) and the CUSTOMER / CUSTOMER_SECURE tables are compared after each task. Seed: every INSERT of GenApp's base/cntl/db2cre.jcl, plus one CUSTOMER row (11) this case adds -- GenApp's ten customers each already have a CUSTOMER_SECURE row, so with GenApp's rows alone the INSERT could only fail; customer 11 stands for the row LGACDB01 has just inserted. A failing INSERT (the auto SQL fault, -803) and a zero-length COMMAREA go to WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE, which LINKs LGSTSQ (below). Derived from the CICS General Insurance Application (GenApp, github.com/cicsdev/cics-genapp; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2020), licensed under the Eclipse Public License 2.0: LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. #4607 / X6 (owner decision): LGSTSQ runs in the same task ("programs"; "region" for its ASSIGN SYSID). An EIBCALEN-0 task (no-commarea) LINKs it with the short ERROR-MSG and ABENDs LGCA, compared whole (the WRITEQ TD and WRITEQ TS it writes too). An error path with the 32500-byte COMMAREA LINKs it a second time with the 99-byte CA-ERROR-MSG; LGSTSQ then writes 104 bytes from its 95-byte WRITE-MSG (X6), so that task is judged up to the refused WRITEQ: what it did before is compared, its end state is not. Not settled on z/OS (#4050). #4270 (X23): a scenario's commarea_length gives the program a COMMAREA shorter than its record -- exactly that many bytes on both sides (a reference past them is refused and the task judged up to it): short-commarea-insert-fails reaches IF EIBCALEN < 91 true.
